x: New faces are badly needed and we are therefore very pleased to welcome 22yrs old David Mayo from the U.S.A. and 27yrs old William Newhill from Coventry.
A particular welcome to David Mayo, a young schoolmaster from U.S.A , who has come to our country to learn all about Walking and to raise himself to International level of performance.

David Mayo, taking part in his first Club Championship, was another to walk well. Improving each time out, on this occasion he was second in the 'Horwood', third in the match and winner of the handicap.
Turn-outs have been disappointing this summer and some faces rarely seen Steve Laker-Jones, David Mayo and Mick Hamlin for instance. We understand the latter is shortly going abroad.

David Mayo has contacted Bob from his American base in East Anglia and could well start showing some form again soon. Bob Farley is expecting to become a father before he leaves Loughborough College in January.
Belgrave walkers scored an impressive win in the "Ipswich 10" with the low scoring of 2nd, 3rd and 5th---David Mayo taking the Suffolk Championship into the bargain.
Dave King made a welcome return to lead the team with Dave Mayo, walking well in his first 20, fourth scoring man.
Dave Mayo, Carl Lawton, Bernard Capener and Brian Ward gave Belgrave a magnificent start to 1968 by defeating strong opposition from Trowbridge and winning the Garnet Cup by just two points.

Gerry Cameron and Dave Mayo are both going great guns at the moment and Bob Farley lacks none of his old fire. Ray Hall too seemed to have taken on a new lease of life although his recent exploits with the paint brush have set him back a bit.
In the USA 50 Kilos Dave Mayo recorded a fine 4:52:00 in his first try at this distance. Also in America John Knifton has been moving fast with a 14.38 " 2 ".

True Bobby Barnes is not yet back to the form (or shape!) of a year ago and it is some time since we have seen or heard Dave Mayo but Carl Lawton and Brian Ward are both showing steady improvement and Gerry Cameron is also going well.
